overview_description.description: OMINVEST, a public joint stock company, is one of Oman's largest companies with a well diversified portfolio of investments in banking, insurance, financial services, commercial and industrial sectors of the economy. The primary objectives of the Company is to participate in ventures which contribute to the economic development of the Sultanate and to function as a fully integrated investment and financial services group. OMINVEST also has positions in a diversified overseas portfolio of marketable securities and private equity investments.
